query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_RETENTIONPOLICY (RETENTIONPOLICY_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT RETENTIONPOLICY_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_RETENTIONPOLICY WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT RETENTIONPOLICY_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_RETENTIONPOLICY WHERE RETENTIONPOLICY_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_RETENTIONPOLICY SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RETENTIONPOLICY_ID = ?
